data_partition.calibration: GOT-10k validation sequence numeric ID modulo 3 equals 1
data_partition.selection: GOT-10k validation sequence numeric ID modulo 3 equals 2
data_partition.confirmation: GOT-10k validation sequence numeric ID modulo 3 equals 0

fixed_policy.threshold_rule: calibration q0.85 coordinate entropy; accept a crop into stable history when entropy <= threshold
fixed_policy.stable_slot_schedule: three evenly spread deterministic indices over accepted-history order; anchor fills stable slots before first accepted crop

selection_gate.run_confirmation_only_if: selection partition AO minus the immutable baseline AO is at least +0.003000
selection_gate.rationale: 0.003 AO is predeclared as a meaningful screen effect before any selection result is read

b_test_policy: No B_test run unless calibration, selection, and confirmation all meet the stated gate and final policy is frozen.
